notes.title: Update 0.365 Now Available
notes.notes: [p]Commanders![/p][p]We are happy to announce that the [b]Update 0.365[/b] is now available![/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="OKRjs94KprA;full"][/previewyoutube][h2]List of Update 0.365 Changes[/h2][p][/p][p][b]Tiger Shark Special Operation and Mission Selection[/b][/p][p]We are happy to present the third mission of the Black Company Special Operation – Tiger Shark! In this mission, the Black Company will take on a notorious pirate warlord deep within his domain, on a pirate island in the Indian Ocean! Read more in our [b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/now-available-special-operation-tiger-shark"]dedicated article.[/url][/b][/p][p]The Tiger Shark Special Operation also introduces the option for players to actually choose which mission from the Black Company series you want to play. Please note:[/p][list][*][p]To play Tiger Shark, new players must finish the two previous missions at least once[/p][/*][*][p]This mechanic is currently not available for other older Special Operation mission series[/p][/*][/list][p][b]African Contract[/b][/p][p]In this update, we’re adding a new contract replacing the old Basurmanin one. As usual, you are able to complete the contract missions in exchange for the following prizes:[/p][list][*][p]Olifant Mk.2 Tier 7 Premium Main Battle Tank for the initial contract completion[/p][/*][*][p]South African camouflage and decals available for contract achievements[/p][/*][*][p]Contract Loot Crate with various camouflages, temporary vehicles and other prizes for further completions[/p][/*][/list][p]As usual, the contract will last several months at least so there is plenty of time to finish it. You can read more about the vehicle in our [b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/upcoming-contract-olifant-mk2"]dedicated article.[/url][/b] Please note, however, that the Olifant MBT is currently not in its final state and we are still working on fixing several issues tied to it.[/p][p][b]Rough Riders Battle Path[/b][/p][p]In this update, we are fixing the following issues of the Rough Riders Battle Path and its vehicles:[/p][list][*][p]Fixed the description of the Solo mission that also requires you to not die before the completion of the objective[/p][/*][*][p]XM1302: Fixed the maximum speed for the upgraded engine to 85 km/h[/p][/*][*][p]XM1302: Fixed the description of the Mitigation passive ability[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Vehicle Fixes and Updates[/b][/p][p]With each patch we continue (and will continue) to update vehicles based on your feedback and fix them. In this update, we have the following changes for you:[/p][list][*][p]BMP-3M: Fixed the infantry door visual model[/p][/*][*][p]VCAC Mephisto: Increased the ammunition carried to 60[/p][/*][/list][p][b]General Changes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue that prevented players from completing a PvE (Heroic) mission in the "Contract from the Unknown 3" Battalion contract[/p][/*][*][p]Several localization fixes[/p][/*][*][p]Added a number of future event assets[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Update 0.360 Now Available
notes.notes: [p]Commanders![/p][p align="start"]We are happy to announce that the [b]Update 0.360[/b] is now available![/p][p align="start"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/90a635665c3c6108652766f6ecbaad593ce61a19.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]List of Update 0.360 Changes[/b][/h2][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"][b]Premium Vehicles for Gold[/b][/p][p align="start"]In this update, we are adding the following Premium vehicles to the dealer trees. These are now available for Gold:[/p][list][*][p]Sophie Wölfli: M60-2000 Tier 7 MBT for 5500 Gold[/p][/*][*][p]Sophie Wölfli: Stryker ADATS Tier 9 TD for 14000 Gold[/p][/*][*][p]Zhang Feng: T-72M2 Wilk Tier 6 MBT for 3250 Gold[/p][/*][*][p]Zhang Feng: WWO Wilk Tier 8 TD for 9000 Gold[/p][/*][*][p]Zhang Feng: VT5 Tier 9 LT for 14000 Gold[/p][/*][*][p]Marat Shishkin: BMPT Mod.2000 Tier 8 TD for 9000 Gold[/p][/*][*][p]Marat Shishkin: Challenger Falcon Tier 8 MBT for 9000 Gold[/p][/*][*][p]Francine De Laroche: Type 90 Tier 7 MBT for 5500 Gold[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][b]XM1302 Adjustment[/b][/p][p align="start"]We have analyzed the statistics of the new XM1302 Light Tank and have determined that the vehicle is a little bit too strong. Alright, not just a little bit – we are looking at 65% PvP winrate, making it currently hands down the best vehicle in the game by a wide margin, which is something that has to be addressed.[/p][p align="start"]We are therefore making the following adjustments:[/p][list][*][p]Removed the Spall Liner module increasing the vehicle’s hitpoints[/p][/*][*][p]Removed the Improved Transmission module increasing the vehicle’s maximum speed[/p][/*][*][p]Improved the vehicle’s hitpoints to 3300[/p][/*][*][p]Improved the vehicle’s maximum speed to 85 km/h[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced the Mitigation ability damage reduction values from 50%/75%/90% to 40%/55%/70% (the ability still reduces module damage taken)[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]In short, we removed two modules but improved the base values to compensate (even a bit beyond the bonus the modules provided) and reduced the damage reduction of the Mitigation ability (the speed thresholds remain the same). The vehicle will still be very powerful (we haven’t nerfed its firepower) but now won’t be all but unstoppable.[/p][p align="start"][b]Rough Riders Battle Path[/b][/p][p align="start"]In this update, we are fixing the following issues of the Rough Riders Battle Path and its vehicles:[/p][list][*][p]We (fingers crossed) fixed the issue plaguing the Battle Path Shop where players weren’t able to buy items due to the fact that what they see in the Shop is not what the server sees. Such desynchronizations should no longer occur[/p][/*][*][p]Rolling Thunder mission can no longer be completed using any vehicle and requires Light Tanks as intended[/p][/*][*][p]All MERDCS camouflages from the main progression are now correctly compensated (one was missing and we will send the missing Battle Coins to the affected players)[/p][/*][*][p]ELKE: Vehicle is now assigned to Oscar Faraday[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][b]Vehicle Fixes and Updates[/b][/p][p align="start"]With each patch we continue (and will continue) to update vehicles based on your feedback and fix them. In this update, we have the following changes for you:[/p][list][*][p]Fixed the collision model of a number of vehicles (T-80B, Type 90-II, VFM5, ZBL-08, Assaulter, BMP-2M, BMP-3M, Challenger 1)[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where attempting to deploy infantry when driving on a slope leads to their instant death[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where it was sometimes impossible to load different shells in the ammunition window[/p][/*][*][p]When firing autocannons in the first person view mode, players can no longer see traces of gunsmoke[/p][/*][*][p]BMPT-72: Fixed an issue that made it impossible to use the Supercharged APS active ability[/p][/*][*][p]BMT-72-140: Fixed the gun depression angles[/p][/*][*][p]BMT-72-140: Removed an incorrect trait from the vehicle (as it does not feature multiple weapon configurations)[/p][/*][*][p]BTR-82A: Small visual model fixes[/p][/*][*][p]Gepard: Fixed an issue causing the aiming reticle to move when switching between first person and third person views[/p][/*][*][p]K1A1: Upgrade modules are now installed by default and do not require unlock[/p][/*][*][p]KF41 Prototype: Small visual model fixes[/p][/*][*][p]KNIFV NLOS: The module adding a bonus to target lock speed from a module is now working correctly (also, we reduced the bonus from 25% to 20%)[/p][/*][*][p]M551 Sheridan: Improved engine now actually improves vehicle performance[/p][/*][*][p]Puma: Tracks no longer move faster than roadwheels[/p][/*][*][p]Shilka: Stock AP shell penetration increased from 60mm to 220mm[/p][/*][*][p]Shilka: Improved AP shell penetration increased from 100mm to 270mm[/p][/*][*][p]Shilka: PELE shell penetration increased from 92mm to 220mm[/p][/*][*][p]T92 and T-92 ACAV: Fixed the visual model (machineguns no longer fly in the air)[/p][/*][*][p]T-62: Fixed the visual model (gun no longer flies in the air)[/p][/*][*][p]T-64BV Mod.2017: Small visual model fixes[/p][/*][*][p]T-90A Burlak: Fixed the flying damaged armor elements on the Gromozeka skin[/p][/*][*][p]TOS-1M: Fixed an issue causing the aiming reticle to move when switching between first person and third person views[/p][/*][*][p]VCAC Mephisto: Improved the time between missile launches from 3s to 2.5s[/p][/*][*][p]VFM5: Added the partial reloading feature again[/p][/*][*][p]ZTZ-20: Small visual model fixes[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][b]General Changes[/b][/p][list][*][p]We continue to research the map loading issues and have implemented several adjustments in order to mitigate their impact (however, the issue is not considered fixed)[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the Beasts of Steel event mission description (added Tier requirement)[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue that produced a black screen upon pressing the Reconnect button (when experiencing a disconnect)[/p][/*][*][p]Rate of Decay: Fixed the collision of several rocks so that players no longer fall through them[/p][/*][*][p]Several smaller localization fixes[/p][/*][*][p]Added a number of future event assets[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Update 0.355 Now Available
notes.notes: [p]Commanders![/p][p align="start"]We are happy to announce that the [b]Update 0.355[/b] is now available![/p][p align="start"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/6a48b502a0c31b8a1b57effb074da7606f5ee542.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]List of Update 0.355 Changes[/b][/h2][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"][b]Economy Changes[/b][/p][p align="start"]As a part of a revitalization of the entire economy of Armored Warfare in order to ensure the game’s longevity, we are making several changes to the game’s economy in regards to Credit income. The changes concern the First Victory of the Day bonus and are as follows:[/p][list][*][p]Special Operations (Hardcore difficulty): from 300% bonus for Credits and XP (x4) once per 3 days to 200% bonus for Credits (x3) and 300% for XP (x4) once per 3 days[/p][/*][*][p]Special Operations (Extreme difficulty): from 300% bonus for Credits and XP (x4) once per 3 days to 200% bonus for Credits (x3) and 300% for XP (x4) once per 3 days[/p][/*][*][p]Special Operations (Heroic difficulty): from 900% bonus for Credits and XP (x10) once per 7 days to 200% bonus for Credits (x3) and 900% for XP (x10) once per 7 days[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]We’ll continue keeping an eye on the Credit situation to make sure the changes have the desired effect.[/p][p align="start"][b]Rough Riders Battle Path[/b][/p][p align="start"]In this update, we are fixing the following issues of the Rough Riders Battle Path and its vehicles:[/p][list][*][p]Forest Green paint is no longer issued three times at Level 43 of the Battle Path[/p][/*][*][p]RDF/LT Ares: Guns now show the correct characteristics in the Garage[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][b]Vehicle Fixes and Updates[/b][/p][p align="start"]With each patch we continue (and will continue) to update vehicles based on your feedback and fix them. In this update, we have the following changes for you:[/p][list][*][p]BMT-72-140: Improved main gun’s depression angles[/p][/*][*][p]Bradley FV: ATGMs no longer ignore launcher elevation and depression[/p][/*][*][p]Leclerc T4: Changed the vehicle’s short name in order for it to be consistent with other Leclerc tanks[/p][/*][*][p]Object 292: Replaced the Kaktus Generation 3 ERA with the intended Malakhit Generation 4 ERA[/p][/*][*][p]T-90A Burlak: Fixed several smaller visual issues with the Gromozeka skin[/p][/*][*][p]T-90A Burlak: Gromozeka skin no longer changes vehicle’s armor[/p][/*][*][p]TOS-1M Buratino: Fixed a bug where the aiming reticle was “jumping” when targeting TOS-1M in battle[/p][/*][*][p]VN20: Deployable turret now also targets enemy infantry (but fires at vehicles with higher priority)[/p][/*][*][p]VN20: Players can now correctly designate targets for the deployable turret (by pressing V, the same way as it works for Mechanized Infantry)[/p][/*][*][p]VN20: Deployable turret fire no longer damages your teammates with splash (shell explosion shockwave) damage[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][b]General Changes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Clarified the mission description for the Beasts of Steel event[/p][/*][*][p]Weekend Special Operation Loot Crates now have a correct description (they drop Rough Riders Battle Coins)[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the Starter Pack reward icons in the game[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed several Battalion Contract mission timers (for M1A2C, BMPT-72 and Challenger 2 Hades vehicles)[/p][/*][*][p]Investigated a number of issues causing the game to crash upon pressing the Reconnect button (an ongoing process)[/p][/*][*][p]Several smaller localization fixes[/p][/*][*][p]Added a number of future event assets[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Update: Battle Coins Expiration
notes.notes: [p]Commanders![/p][p]We would like to remind you that, much like during the previous Battle Path campaigns, the Battle Coins acquired during the Shadow Protocol Battle Path will [b]not carry over.[/b][/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/altbanner_1920x1080_0.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Please make sure you spend your remaining Battle Coins before the end of the Shadow Protocol Battle Path (July 22, 5:00 CEST)![/b][/p][p]Furthermore, please make sure you [b]open any and all in-game Battle Path loot crates containing Shadow Protocol Battle Coins.[/b] It will not be possible to use them in the next Battle Path.[/p][p]We hope that you enjoyed this Battle Path campaign and, as always:[/p][p][b]See you on the battlefield![/b][/p]

notes.title: Developer Diary: Light Tank Changes
notes.notes: [p]Commanders![/p][p]As you already know, the [b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/rough-riders-battle-path-info-and-preorder"]Rough Riders Battle Path[/url][/b] is coming in July and the main topic of it will be the history of armored cavalry – or, in game terms, Light Tanks. Upon reviewing the performance of the entire class, we discovered that while some of them are performing adequately or even very well (MPF comes to mind), some others are in serious need of improvements. Today, we’ll tell you more about them.[/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/0.19main_img_4.jpg"][/img][/p][p]At this moment, we are working on the following changes:[/p][list][*][p][b]Tier 1[/b] PT-85: Improved HEAT damage and penetration (440mm, 310 damage) and reduced reload time from 4.68s to 4s[/p][/*][*][p][b]Tier 2[/b] T92 (and T92 ACAV): Improved camouflage from 25% to 30% and reduced reload time from 3 to 2.6s[/p][/*][*][p][b]Tier 3[/b] Scorpion: Improved camouflage from 25% to 30%[/p][/*][*][p][b]Tier 4[/b] Scorpion 90: Improved camouflage from 25% to 30%, viewrange increased from 340m to 440m, improved AP shell damage and penetration (550mm, 290 damage), improved AP shell damage and penetration (605mm, 390 damage)[/p][/*][/list][p]Please note that the Scorpion 90 shell adjustments will also be made to LAV-300 as it uses the same shells. Let’s continue:[/p][list][*][p][b]Tier 5[/b] M551 Sheridan: Increased its mobility by improving acceleration (2.8s and 11s respectively) and hull traverse (63 deg/s)[/p][/*][/list][p]Begleitpanzer 57 is performing very well for its Tier and does not need any buffs.[/p][list][*][p][b]Tier 6[/b] RDF/LT: The gun is manually loaded on this model so the vehicle will receive a loader.[/p][/*][/list][p]In fact, the [b]RDF/LT[/b] (which is obtainable as a prize from the Rough Riders Battle Path) is received a larger number of buffs, so let’s take a closer look at thus vehicle. The following changes will be taking place:[/p][list][*][p]Improved camouflage from 25% to 30%[/p][/*][*][p]M464 AP shell penetration increased from 550mm to 575mm[/p][/*][*][p]M464 AP shell damage increased from 260 to 290[/p][/*][*][p]T70E3 HESH shell damage increased from 230 to 260[/p][/*][*][p]0 to 32 km/h acceleration improved to 1.65s[/p][/*][*][p]0 to max acceleration improved to 11s[/p][/*][*][p]Maximum speed increased to 90 km/h[/p][/*][*][p]Maximum reverse increased to 40 km/h[/p][/*][*][p]Hull traverse rate increased to 77.49 deg/s[/p][/*][/list][p]Moving on to other Tier 6 Light Tanks:[/p][list][*][p][b]Tier 6[/b] Expeditionary Tank: Viewrange increased from 410m to 420m[/p][/*][*][p][b]Tier 6[/b] Stingray 1: Reload time within magazine improved from 3 to 2.7s[/p][/*][*][p][b]Tier 6[/b] VFM 5: Vehicle now has a 7-round magazine with 2.7s between shots within and 20s full magazine reload (partial reload is possible), we have also gave the vehicle a new HE shell with 55mm of penetration and 690 damage[/p][/*][/list][p]On Tier 7, CV90105 TML requires no buffs as it is performing fairly well. The same can be said of Stingray 2, therefore:[/p][list][*][p][b]Tier 7[/b] TAM 2IP: Increased hitpoints from 2200 to 2400, improved camouflage from 25% to 30%, improved viewrange from 430m to 440m and improved acceleration (3.53s and 15.39s respectively)[/p][/*][/list][p]Coming up on Tier 8, most Light Tanks perform fairly well. Harimau, Griffin 120mm and Leopard Cockerill do not need any improvements. Did we mention we’d be adding Griffin 120mm to the Rough Riders prize pool? Because we will, but more on that later. For now, there are three tanks that need to be addressed here. First is the [b]ASCOD:[/b][/p][p]This vehicle has two turrets – a manned one and an unmanned one.[/p][list][*][p]We removed the Ready Rack mechanism from the manned one and set the regular reload time to 3.5s[/p][/*][*][p]The unmanned turret reload time within its magazine was improved from 4s to 2s[/p][/*][/list][p]And now, the bigger stuff. [b]Dragun 125[/b] is getting a larger set of changes, including:[/p][list][*][p]Improved camouflage from 20% to 25%[/p][/*][*][p]Maximum speed increased to 75 km/h[/p][/*][*][p]Reload time improvement from 5.14s to 4.9s[/p][/*][*][p]Viewrange improvement from 430m to 440m[/p][/*][*][p]Vehicle received a new Invar-M tandem HEAT ATGM with 1050mm of penetration and 770 damage[/p][/*][*][p]Vehicle received a new 3UBK14F1 thermobaric ATGM with 80mm of penetration and 1000 damage[/p][/*][/list][p]And [b]M8-105 Buford[/b] is receiving the following changes:[/p][list][*][p]Reload time improvement from 3.74s to 3.5s[/p][/*][*][p]Increased hitpoints from 2500 to 2750[/p][/*][*][p]Viewrange improvement from 430m to 450m[/p][/*][*][p]HEAT round M152/6 now offers 810mm penetration and 610 damage[/p][/*][*][p]Added a new transmission module adding 2.5% bonus to acceleration 10% bonus to hull traverse[/p][/*][/list][p]On Tier 9, CV90120T Ghost is performing well enough, as are ZTQ-15 and Anders. Remaining are the VT-5 and M8-120 Thunderbolt II. The [b]VT-5[/b] is receiving the following changes:[/p][list][*][p]Increased the BTA2 APFSDS shell penetration to 740mm (ZTL-11 uses similar shell, there it is increased to 800mm)[/p][/*][*][p]Added a new HE shell, DTB2 from ZTL-11[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the amount of ammo carried from 54 to 66[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the amount of APS charges to 12[/p][/*][/list][p]The [b]M8-120 Thunderbolt[/b] (and its Hades version) is receiving the following changes:[/p][list][*][p]0 to 32 km/h acceleration improved from 3.93s to 3.5s[/p][/*][*][p]0 to max acceleration improved to 17s[/p][/*][*][p]Increased hitpoints from 2650 to 2800[/p][/*][*][p]Reload time improvement from 4.21s to 4s[/p][/*][*][p]Viewrange improvement from 430m to 440m[/p][/*][/list][p]And, last but not least, there’s the highest Tier. On Tier 10 there are only three Light Tanks (as of now) and two of the three perform really well – especially the MPF. The [b]K21 XC-8[/b] is getting the following buffs:[/p][list][*][p]Increased hitpoints from 2650 to 2900[/p][/*][*][p]Reload time improvement from 3.53s to 2.7s[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the amount of APS charges to 8[/p][/*][/list][p]And that’s it. There are several more buffs we are working on, but those are not related directly to Light Tanks. From American vehicles, the T249 Vigilante will receive a different Gatling gun mechanic (similar to the M48 GAU-8) along with a shell penetration buff, some improvements to Shilka (mostly penetration) and VCAC Mephisto (increasing the amount of missiles carried and some reload times), all based on your feedback.[/p][p]We hope that you’ll enjoy the changes and, as always:[/p][p][b]See you on the battlefield![/b][/p]

notes.title: Update 0.320 Now Available
notes.notes:
Commanders!

We are happy to announce that the [b]Update 0.320[/b] is now available!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/6d2f52c7e4712ebb9846cd66f3446b064c44d462.png[/img]

[h2]List of Update 0.320 Changes[/h2]

[h3]Object 292[/h3]

In this update, we are adding the Object 292 Tier 10 progression Main Battle Tank. In order to unlock the tank, you need to gather a certain amount of points using the T-80BVM Tier 9 progression Main Battle Tank. To read more about its history and mechanics visit our [url=https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-object-292]In Development article[/url].

[b]Vehicle Fixes and Updates[/b]

With each patch we continue (and will continue) to update vehicles based on your feedback and fix them. In this update, we have the following changes for you:

[list]
[*] Ajax: Fixed the Desert Ajax skin appearance
[*] BMP-2M: Fixed the overprogression module cost
[*] BTR-82A: Fixed the overprogression module cost
[*] BTR-82A: Armor now shows the correct values
[*] BVP M-80A: Upgraded ATGM module is now correctly marked as an upgrade
[*] Cheonma-2: DTP-125 HEAT shell now deals 930 damage (corrected to make the damage consistent with other high-tier Chinese shells)
[*] Centauro 105: Armor values in their module descriptions now appear correctly
[*] CV90 Mk.IV: Improved Autoloader module now works as described
[*] Merkava Mk.4M: Fixed an issue where it was impossible to use the Supercharged APS active ability
[*] T-15: Improved Ammo Feed module now works as described
[*] VN17: HE shells now display the correct explosion effect
[*] WWO Wilk: Fixed the gun module icon
[*] XM1A3: Aces skin now correctly unlocks and installs the top hard-kill APS
[/list]

[b]General Changes[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed a number of texture problems on low and medium graphics settings (dark terrain, bright green terrain, missing textures and so on)
[*] Fixed the duration of the grenade smoke visual effect (the mechanic itself was unaffected, only the smoke disappeared earlier than intended)
[*] Fixed several localization issues
[*] Added a number of new assets
[/list]

notes.title: Update 0.310 Now Available
notes.notes:
Commanders!

We are happy to announce that the Update 0.310 is now available!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/b55b3cb6b10ebd1217cf94152a2194711f5e66f7.png[/img]

[h3]List of Update 0.310 Changes[/h3]

[b]Gold Subscription Resolution[/b]

In order to resolve the ongoing issues with the Gold Subscription event once and for all, we have decided to take the following steps to make sure that players receive all the Gold they are due:

[list]
[*]     Gold Subscription officially ends on April 24 for everyone
[*]     Players with Gold Subscription will receive 300 Gold for every missed day between April 12 and April 24 (both dates included) – for example, if you missed 3 days for whatever reason, you will receive 900 Gold)
[*]     Furthermore, players with Gold Subscription will also receive 300 Gold for every day on the counter after April 24
[/list]

That way, nobody will be left missing anything.

[b]Apocalypse Special Operation for the Weekend[/b]

Five new Special Operation missions from the Apocalypse story arc will appear in the weekend Special Operation rotation. These are:

[list]
[*]     Plague
[*]     Famine
[*]     War
[*]     Death
[*]     Burning Grounds
[/list]

The same rules apply for these as they do for the other weekend Special Operation missions. Achievements from these missions are now obtainable and the missions award the appropriate amount of Special Operation Loot Crates.

[b]Vehicle Fixes and Updates[/b]

With each patch we continue (and will continue) to update vehicles based on your feedback and fix them. In this update, we have the following changes for you:

[list]
[*]     Updated the traits of a large number of vehicles in order to match their current state
[*]     BMP-2M: Fixed the issue where guided missiles ignore their launcher’s elevation
[*]     KNIFV NLOS LPS: Fixed the disappearing launchers on the destroyed model
[*]     PLZ-05: Fixed the smoke and phosphorus ammo reload time
[*]     T-64BV Mod.2017: Fixed the gun depression angles when aiming over the mudguards
[*]     T-64BV Mod.2017: Widened the smoke area from smoke grenades
[*]     T-64BV Mod.2017: Autoloader internal module is now correctly moving within the turret
[*]     Small visual fixes on several vehicles and skins
[/list]

[b]General Changes[/b]

[list]
[*]     Ladder challenges (currently available in the launcher) are now available within the Garage
[*]     Loot Crates in Armored Warfare now display their content with corresponding drop chances
[*]     Fixed several issues of the Battle Path shop in order to prevent cases where players see items they cannot buy (because the server sees something else)
[*]     Fixed the Battalion Contract cooldowns for M8-120, T-90MS and Leopard 2A6 Hades contracts
[*]     Added several new assets for future events
[*]     Fixed several localization issues
[/list]

notes.title: Update 0.290 Now Available
notes.notes:
Commanders!

We are happy to announce that the [b]Update 0.290[/b] is now available!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/4b7ecc6378f7ea2c6883854ea8cb03bc309daca5.png[/img]

[h2]List of Update 0.290 Changes[/h2]

[b]Shadow Protocol Battle Path[/b]

We are rolling out a new four-month-long Battle Path featuring a lot of exciting content, including the following prizes:

[list]
[*]     Three brand-new vehicles
[*]     Mercenary Loot Crates
[*]     Epic skins and numerous camouflages
[/list]

And much more! The prizes can be explored in [url=https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/shadow-protocol-battle-path-prize-highlights]this article[/url] and you can read about the entire Battle Path in our [url=https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/shadow-protocol-battle-path-info-and-preorder]dedicated article[/url].

Please note:

[list]
[*]     KNIFV NLOS LPS Tier 10 Premium Tank Destroyer fires (in its final version) two missiles in the lock-on (“Javelin”) mode and one missile in the standard mode
[*]     Repair Zone now heals 30 hp/s in PvE and 15 hp/s in PvP and can be recharged by pressing the Q button in PvE
[*]     Borsuk was considerably buffed compared to the initial article, check it out!
[*]     The release version of Shadow Protocol has the same Battle Path Shop content as the previous Battle Path, additional content will be added to the shop in a future update
[*]     Missions currently cannot be completed on legacy “reskin” vehicles (such as T-72AV ICE)
[/list]

[b]CATTB Improvements[/b]

Yes, you’re reading correctly. CATTB is getting buffed. The core idea here is to increase its firepower and to bring its armor to the same layout as on other Abrams series tanks (which were buffed in Update 0.240).

However, as the CATTB has its active suspension ability that allows the vehicle to tilt its hull, we have decided to compensate the firepower by making the upper frontal plate a bit thinner. Instead of just a straight buff, you now also have to play with the suspension in order to cover your weakspots. You are effectively trading some protection for gun depression angle (by tilting the hull up and hiding your weakspot) and you need to decide what you need more. In return, you get a major boost in firepower. In other words:

[list]
[*]     Increased the armor of lower frontal plate (except for the lowest part, which was made thinner the way it is on other Abrams tanks)
[*]     Increased the roof armor from 100mm to 150mm
[*]     140mm gun ready rack reload time improved from 14s to 9s
[/list]

[b]Vehicle Fixes and Updates[/b]

With each patch we continue (and will continue) to update vehicles based on your feedback and fix them. In this update, we have the following changes for you:

[list]
[*]     BM Oplot: Improved Kombat ATGM penetration from 1000mm to 1025mm
[*]     BM Oplot: Improved Kombat ATGM high-explosive shell damage from 150 to 275
[*]     BMP-1AM Basurmanin: Significantly reduced the camouflage penalty for firing the autocannon
[*]     Cheonma-2: Improved the gun depression of its grenade launcher
[*]     KTO Rosomak: Improved the acceleration of the stock engine
[*]     KTO Rosomak: Added a new top engine (610hp DC13)
[*]     KTO Rosomak: Added a new 40mm Bushmaster autocannon variant similar to the Bradley
[*]     KTO Rosomak: Slightly reduced the camouflage penalty for firing the autocannon
[*]     T-64BV Mod.2017: Improved frontal armor to T-64BV Mod.2022 level
[*]     T-64BV Mod.2017: Fixed the ERA appearance in Armor Inspector
[*]     T-72 Ural: Added two new top shells (3VBM9 APFSDS and 3VBK10 HEAT)
[*]     T-72 Ural: Added a new top engine (840hp V-84)
[*]     T-80BVM: Fixed the broken mudguard textures
[*]     VN20: Turret ability can now be recharged by pressing the Q button in PvE
[*]     XM1A3: Aces skin now correctly unlocks and installs the top hard-kill APS
[*]     XM1A3: Fixed the dirt appearance on the Aces skin
[/list]

[b]General Changes[/b]

After an analysis that included thorough checks of match chat logs, we have determined that the ability to talk to the enemy team in PvP matches serves no real gameplay purpose and is overwhelmingly used for insults and griefing. As a part of our fight against such behavior, we have removed the option to send messages to the enemy team from PvP matches.

Furthermore:

[list]
[*]     Fixed an issue with the Battle Path shop where players sometimes saw incorrect offers (this includes the “entire shop offer appears as owned already” problem)
[*]     Fixed the dirt system for desert environments (tanks previously looked excessively dirty)
[*]     Fixed the mirroring issues of several decals
[*]     Fixed several localization issues
[/list]

notes.title: Developer Diary: Shadow Protocol Changes
notes.notes:
Commanders!

It’s been some time since the announcement of the [url=https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/shadow-protocol-battle-path-info-and-preorder]Shadow Protocol Battle Path[/url], currently bound to appear in early April. We also discussed the upcoming [url=https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/shadow-protocol-battle-path-prize-highlights]vehicles and prizes[/url] but the thing is, we made some adjustments since the initial announcement. Let’s take a look at them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/f1885d73d3f37fa9e1263ef1cc9a134637471f66.jpg[/img]

First, the [b]KNIFV NLOS LPS[/b]. Based on our testing, this vehicle required only minor changes compared to the first version. One thing we did, however, is adjust the missile lock time (reduced for single launches from 3.5s to 3s between missiles) and trajectory to become more practical. The vehicle also had a long spotting range, which we reduced to 390m. Overall, despite its somewhat wacky look, the vehicle is highly viable.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/fcfe4ed2b7bc63f2ba7fd301469dc429ff05e45c.jpg[/img]

Secondly there’s the [b]Borsuk[/b]. The biggest question about this vehicle was its ability’s rate of repair. The current setting is 30 hitpoints per second.

We have also rebalanced the vehicle’s frontal protection (it’ll be better protected from kinetic rounds and less from HEAT rounds and ATGMs), improved the missile reload time and increased the rate of fire.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/da66583df77286a8b7b1a5508b2b5894531b9818.jpg[/img]

And, finally, there’s the [b]T-64BV Mod.2022[/b]. The big thing here is the frontal armor buff, which the T-64BV Mod.2017 is also getting. The upper frontal plate armor is becoming more durable for both vehicles.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/cb3dcb30b4ee0f456f62527a2faba31028a200fc.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/8ef1f16fcbf2409ccdad0abb8578b9384c0cbfef.jpg[/img]

Other than that there were minor issues – we buffed the Kombat gun-launched guided missile on the T-64BV and the Oplot (increased penetration by 25mm, higher non-penetration damage) and reduced the hitpoints from 2800 to 2600 (the same amount the T-64BV Mod.2017 has as they are essentially identical vehicles).

In this update, we are addressing the matter of TOS-1M and its gameplay. The vehicle currently has two issues. notes.title: Developer Diary: Battle Path Commander Changes
notes.notes:
Commanders!

In the [url=https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/battle-path-info-and-preorder]Seahawks Battle Path article[/url], we mentioned that the three commanders featured as prizes in the Seahawks Battle Path would be getting an update.

These commanders are:

[list]
[*]     Joshua Seagrove
[*]     Kathryn Grey
[*]     Fyodor Sokolov
[/list]

Without further ado, here’s what we’ve done.

[b]Joshua Seagrove[/b] is and always has been intended as a wheeled Tank Destroyer commander since his vehicle is canonically a Stryker by the name of Avenger (featured as a skin in the Battle Path prizes).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/70e442c858ce30ee1fcf6cfe255db05dd386b09d.jpg[/img]

His focus should be on firepower, module destruction and camouflage. Therefore:

[list]
[*]     Joshua Seagrove’s main skill is now static (available in full state right from the initial rank) and provides 7% reload speed buff at the expense of 25% hitpoints
[*]     Two Tier 3 skills providing 3.33% bonus to rate of fire after destroying a module) got improved to 5% and moved to the corners of the field
[*]     Two Tier 3 skills providing 6.89% camouflage penalty reduction for firing a gun got improved to 8% and moved to the corners of the field
[*]     The entire vicinity of the main skill is now filled with Eagle Eye skills (increasing the ability to see through foliage)
[*]     Two Marksman skills (improving accuracy) are also above and below the main skill
[/list]


[b]Kathryn Grey[/b] is supposed to be an effective Abrams commander given her canonical lore choice of driving an M1A3 Abrams (also featured as a skin in the Battle Path).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/00df7db4794c4ad60248687dfe40d8ab9fd33c03.jpg[/img]

Once again, her focus is on MBT firepower. Therefore:

[list]
[*]     Kathryn Grey’s main skill was upgraded and received a new name, Warfighter. It now scales with ranks and provides up to 8% reload time improvement as long as you drive an MBT
[*]     The not-so-useful Track and Destroy skills in lower right corner were replaced by two fields of skills providing 15% chance to deal maximum damage (30% in total)
[*]     We have removed various condition skills triggering whenever an enemy is within 50m and replaced them with hull traverse skills without this condition
[*]     In the center of the field (that was previously empty) there is a new skill providing reload time improvement as long as there are no enemies present within 50m (regardless of class)
[/list]


And, finally, [b]Fyodor Sokolov[/b] is getting a set of smaller changes. His essence remains the same – he will provide an XP bonus, making him highly suitable as a commander for new players.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/8711810282d204b6831ea84b02d7085cc02f3c1f.jpg[/img]

However:

    The top rank XP bonus is increased from 40% to 50%
    Replaced the Texas Duel skill (increasing accuracy) on the left side with another third rank repair skill
    On the left middle side, the ATGM and accuracy skills were replaced by Motivation skills (increasing crew statistics)

Please note that Maximilian König (previously a “clone” of this commander skill-wise) is not getting this overhaul and from now on will be different. As for Samuel Thorpe (who’s not connected to the Battle Path), he will receive a deeper overhaul that will be described in a separate article.

We hope that you will enjoy these changes and, as always:

See you on the battlefield!

notes.title: Developer Diary: U.S. Vehicle Changes
notes.notes:
Commanders!

The [url=https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/battle-path-info-and-preorder]Seahawks Battle Path[/b][/url] is right around the corner and along with it come the American vehicle buffs we have announced in the article. So let’s take a look at them together.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/5827b8ef16d2d741e3e629e016f787e923533237.png[/img]

American vehicles have long been the “baseline” of Armored Warfare in the sense they aren’t really good or bad in any particular aspects. They are just “there” and with the introduction of more and more specialized vehicles, they got pushed into the background a bit. Well, no more, because in the next update, they are becoming awesome.

Let’s start with the [b]M1128 Stryker[/b], Joshua Seagrove’s favorite Tank Destroyer. It’s becoming a really mean vehicle on the battlefield with the following changes:

[list]
[*]     For the autoloader configuration we are changing the reload time within magazine from 3.54s to 2s
[*]     Added new HEAT-MP round with 855mm penetration and 610 damage
[*]     Added new APFSDS round with 760mm penetration and 470 damage
[*]     Significantly increased the vehicle’s agility
[/list]

Next is the [b]Bradley Fighting Vehicle[/b], the workhorse of the Seahawks. This vehicle’s performance has so far been mediocre, which is why we have made the following changes:

[list]
[*]     Added the 600hp VTA-903T engine (this significantly increases its mobility)
[*]     30mm and 40mm variants of the same gun are now separate modules with the 40mm gun having a new HE round
[*]     Added a new tandem HEAT warhead ATGM (with the same penetration and damage as the previous one but improved flight characteristics)
[*]     Added a new thermobaric warhead ATGM
[/list]

In other words, the Bradley’s becoming faster and hard-hitting. But the main part of the changes concerns the [b]Abrams MBT series[/b].

For starters, most of the Abrams tanks are getting a frontal armor overhaul. It’s an overall buff to the frontal armor, but some parts are actually becoming thinner. Simply put, the Abrams frontal armor’s about to behave differently and it’s up to you to learn how to deal with the nasty beasts that are the new Abrams tanks. It’s certainly possible, just not a matter of a single button push.

Next, let’s discuss the specific vehicles, starting with the [b]Tier 10 XM1A3[/b], which hasn’t been performing great as of late. On the contrary, it needed a serious buff, which is why we made the following changes:

[list]
[*]     ARAT-2 ERA is now working correctly against tandem warheads (this was more a bug fix than a buff and is a mechanical change rather than a value increase, feel free to test it in game)
[*]     Added a new Trophy Next Gen APS module with Supercharged APS ability
[*]     Increased the initial acceleration for both engines
[*]     120mm gun now has a new M1147 AMP remote detonation HE round
[*]     120mm M829E4 APFSDS damage increased from 600 to 650
[*]     140mm gun reload time improved from 9.8s to 9s
[*]     140mm gun accuracy of APFSDS and HEAT shells increased
[/list]

With the frontal armor buff, the XM1A3’s bound to become one of the best MBTs in Armored Warfare, period.

Next, the [b]Tier 9 M1A2C (and its Hades variant).[/b] Aside from the frontal armor buff, we are making the following adjustments:

[list]
[*]     Fixed an issue where the properties of ARAT-2 ERA didn’t change properly with this module installed
[*]     ARAT-2 ERA is now working correctly against tandem warheads (same fix as for XM1A3)
[*]     Added a new M1147 AMP remote detonation HE round
[*]     Increased the initial acceleration for both engines
[*]     Reload speed improved from 6.7s to 6s
[*]     Significantly increased hull traverse from 33 deg/s to 44 deg/s
[/list]

For the [b]Tier 8 M1A2[/b], aside from the frontal armor buff as usual, we are making the following changes:

[list]
[*]     Added a new M908 HE round (840 damage, 50mm penetration)
[*]     Increased the initial acceleration of the engine
[*]     Reload speed improved from 6.7s to 6s
[*]     Significantly increased hull traverse from 33 deg/s to 44 deg/s
[/list]

Following is the [b]Tier 8 Premium M1A1 AIM[/b], previously one of the most mediocre tanks of Armored Warfare. We checked its statistics and decided it finally deserves a proper buff. Therefore, aside from the frontal armor improvement, we have made the following changes:

[list]
[*]     APFSDS round changed from M829A1 to M829A2 (740mm penetration, 540 damage)
[*]     Added new XM943 STAFF top-attack HEAT round
[*]     Added new M908 HE round (840 damage, 50mm penetration)
[*]     Increased the initial acceleration of the engine
[*]     Significantly increased hull traverse from 33 deg/s to 44 deg/s
[/list]

The [b]Tier 7 M1A1[/b] can’t be left out either. You know the drill by now – frontal armor upgrade. But also:

[list]
[*]     Added new M908 HE round (840 damage, 50mm penetration
[*]     Reload speed improved from 6.7s to 6s
[*]     Increased the initial acceleration of the engine
[*]     Significantly increased hull traverse from 33 deg/s to 44 deg/s
[/list]

We’re coming to an end now. What’s left is the [b]Tier 6 M1[/b] with the frontal armor adjustment but also:

[list]
[*]     Added a new armor module that improves the frontal turret and hull armor even further
[*]     Added a new APFSDS round (690mm penetration, 430 damage)
[*]     Increased the initial acceleration of the engine
[*]     Reload speed improved from 5.8s to 5.4s
[*]     Significantly increased hull traverse from 25 deg/s to 41 deg/s
[/list]

The rest of the Abrams tanks (XM1, M1A1 Storm) performed well enough in order not to warrant major buffs but we didn’t forget them either:

[list]
[*]     XM1 (and XM1 Fox): APFSDS round changed to M833 (690mm penetration, 430 damage)
[*]     M1A1 Storm: Increased the initial acceleration of the engine (this will help nicely with your ramming maneuvers)
[*]     M1A1 Storm: Significantly increased hull traverse from 32.9 deg/s to 44 deg/s
[/list]

And that’s about it, commanders. The Abrams tanks should retain their jack-of-all-trades characteristics but at a significantly higher level now. We hope that you’ll enjoy devastating your opponents with them and, as always:

[b]See you on the battlefield![/b]

notes.title: The Shockwave Update is now available!
notes.notes:
Commanders!

As announced earlier, the [b]Shockwave update[/b] (Update 0.235) is now available in Armored Warfare.

[previewyoutube=6ztGOpNW9Ic;full][/previewyoutube]

Here’s what it’s bringing.

[h2]Shockwave Mode[/h2]

The Shockwave mode is an endgame survival mode for advanced players in which a team of five fights of waves of ever-increasing difficulty. The longer you survive, the higher the rewards. Do you have what it takes to become the best team in Armored Warfare? Because that’s pretty much what’s at stake here – this is the endgame mode of Armored Warfare.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/2c57f2a0094421cd1a7325270a84892941fd0f8a.jpg[/img]

The mode is available during all hours for both platoons and solo players who can join the queue to be matched with others. This mode is initially available for one month only (“Season 0” launch) and will therefore temporarily go away somewhere along the launch of the upcoming Seahawks Battle Path which is planned for November.

You can enter Shockwave battles by using the dedicated panel in the PvE UI.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/ce842361dbf9234aab887ef3b358e39f40616fee.jpg[/img]

As for the mode details:

[list]
[*]     This mode is available for Tier 10 vehicles only (no vehicles are excluded)
[*]     There is no time limit per match, you need to hold on for as long as you can
[*]     There are no respawns but you can use your consumables to repair
[*]     Enemy vehicles spawn in waves and each wave arrives from one of several different directions (the types of enemies and directions are randomized so no two matches will be identical)
[*]     Enemy vehicle wrecks despawn immediately upon destruction and therefore cannot be used for cover
[*]     New enemy types appear in this mode (vehicles that cannot be seen in any other mission)
[*]     Ammunition replenishes automatically (periodically, with a sound indicator)
[/list]

Please do be also aware of the following:

[list]
[*]     You currently cannot complete contracts or Battle Path missions in this mode
[*]     Some performance and bot behavior issues do exist and we are aware of them
[/list]

The launch of the mode is accompanied by the [b]Shockwave[/b] Event where you can earn exclusive Season 0 rewards (including camouflages, Gold and an animated avatar) by playing the Shockwave mode every day and destroying enemies.

[h3]Shockwave Prizes[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/a0a7d3756ad0f90e4eedb8253327071774cd7831.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/ddea18451363cdc654d6ae81c6b4d5f5e9dc4cd9.jpg[/img]


[h2]Pipelines Map Overhaul[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/cdd2050892503dcd8765b58e4a05cc073aa94754.jpg[/img]

We have overhauled the visuals of the Pipelines PvP map to improve the graphics of Armored Warfare. You can read more about it in our [url=https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-pipelines-overhaul]dedicated article.[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/b316e4b8e3455f415c0b19eab484802f7b07946b.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/0f66f7d69e0f0641a5c0c252eab6ba34ad335249.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/feefbfe6aba85faff021f4597d14c322af782a4e.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/f7e4f5f3aecb480a410350ea0a496c28cc9025b4.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/760e878bf8f9a076f892693f55f402369d138a00.jpg[/img]


[h2]Dynamic Decals[/h2]

The in-game decals can now be moved, rotated (by holding Alt and scrolling your mouse wheel) and their size can be changed (by holding Shift and scrolling your mouse wheel).

Video demonstration of the system:

[previewyoutube=zTZT5wbGFIk;full][/previewyoutube]

Please note that the system still has some limitations:

[list]
[*]     This system only applies to decals, not to battalion emblems
[*]     There still are just two decals per vehicle
[*]     Decals cannot be placed on ERA or other additional armor plates, they will always appear on the base hull of the vehicle
[/list]


[h2]New Engine and Gun Sounds[/h2]

The T-72 series and several other vehicles are getting new engine sounds as the first step in the announced sound overhaul. You can hear a demonstration of the sound in the following video:

[previewyoutube=Th8hCcg5Fng;full][/previewyoutube]

This affects the following vehicles:

[list]
[*]     T-72 Ural
[*]     T-72A
[*]     T-72AV
[*]     T-72B
[*]     T-72B3
[*]     T-72M1
[*]     T-90
[*]     Object 787 Gadyuka
[*]     Msta-S
[*]     M-95 Degman
[*]     Seon’gun-915
[*]     Type 96
[*]     Type 96A
[/list]

We have also added a new 125mm gun sound to the following vehicles:

[list]
[*]     T-72 Ural
[*]     T-72A
[*]     T-72M1
[/list]

You can hear a demonstration of the sound in the following video:

[previewyoutube=jaH5fEzlxkw;full][/previewyoutube]


[h2]PELE Overhaul[/h2]

In this update, we are overhauling all PELE shells to use a modified HESH mechanism. What it means is that these shells will be very useful against sloped surfaces and thinly armored targets, dealing tremendous damage in situations where regular AP shells would not be as useful. The vast majority of PELE shells belong to autocannons and will therefore serve either as an upgrade or an alternative shell to the already existing ones. Regarding the full caliber PELE shells:

[list]
[*]     Wilk’s PELE shells will become considerably more powerful
[*]     Arjun already has HESH rounds and PELE (PCB) shells will serve simply as an upgrade to them
[/list]

You can read more about it in our [url=https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-dynamic-decals]dedicated article.[/url]



[h2]Friendly Fire Adjustments[/h2]

We have had situations before where players would be kicked out of the match for inadvertently dealing friendly fire damage to their teammates. This most notably affected artillery (dealing damage with large caliber HE blast wave) and ammo rack explosions (which count as “your” damage when an enemy tank explodes but the blast wave from the explosion deals damage to a friendly target).

In this update, dealing damage to friendlies will no longer kick you from the match but will simply result in your ability to deal damage to friendlies being disabled. Your vehicle will be marked blue and dealing damage to it will not result in any punishment.



[h2]Other Changes[/h2]

[b]New Crew and Commander Upgrades[/b]

We are adding the sixth crew training level to the game. Alongside it you will be able to choose a third skill from those already available. Additionally, it’s now possible to easier unlock Commander levels with a single button by purchasing the required XP.

notes.title: Introducing the Shockwave Update
notes.notes:
Commanders!

We’re finally happy to introduce “[b]Shockwave[/b]”, the largest Armored Warfare update in recent history, is coming this autumn.

[previewyoutube=GLft7XbinyI;full][/previewyoutube]

Without further ado, here’s what you can look forward to.

[b][h2]Shockwave – Part 1[/h2][/b]

[list]
[*]     [b]Shockwave mode[/b] – a new endgame cooperative PvE in-game mode in which players must survive progressively tougher enemies to see who survives the longest. The mode will be accompanied by a special event with unique prizes. You can read more about it in our [url=https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-endgame-pve-mode]dedicated article[/url]
[*]     [b]New sounds[/b] – the T-72 series and several other vehicles are getting new engine sounds as the first step in the announced sound overhaul. You can read more about them in our [url=https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-new-sounds]dedicated article[/url]
[*]     [b]Pipelines map overhaul[/b] – we have overhauled the visuals of the Pipelines PvP map to improve the graphics of Armored Warfare. You can read more about it in our dedicated article
[*]     [b]Dynamic decals[/b] – you can now place your decals pretty much anywhere on the vehicle. You can read more about it in our [url=https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-pipelines-overhaul]dedicated article[/url]
[*]     [b]PELE overhaul[/b] – all PELE shells are changing their mechanics to improve their usefulness. No more various PELE shells with a different mechanic each. This feature will be described in a future article
[/list]

This update will be followed by its second part:

[b][h2]Shockwave – Part 2[/h2][/b]

[b]Drones and Anti-Drone Measures[/b] – a new type of gameplay is making its appearance in Armored Warfare. Several existing vehicles will be equipped with attack or recon drones. Other vehicles will receive new airburst shells to fight them as well as active abilities. You can read more about them in our [url=https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-drones-and-anti-drone-defense]dedicated article.[/url]

The Shockwave update will of course come with its own bug fixes and other smaller quality of life improvements to the game. Additionally, we’re working on the recently announced [url=https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/battle-path-info-and-preorder]Seahawks Battle Path[/url] that’ll give you even more things to do in the game.

We hope that you’ll enjoy the update and, as always:

[b]See you on the battlefield![/b]

[b]Modern APFSDS Ammunition Fix[/b]

In Armored Warfare, there is a type of APFSDS ammunition that’s called “modern” – vehicles with these kinetic shells are able to defeat a single layer of ERA (much like tandem HEAT warheads).

Previously, the only way how to tell the vehicle’s kinetic shell has this property was to check the Traits section of the vehicle’s description. As a result, very few players knew about it because the shells themselves still showed as standard shells. In this update, we have created two new ammunition categories:

[list]
[*] APFSDS-M (Modern APFSDS)
[*] APFSDS-MDU (Modern APFSDS with Depleted Uranium penetrator)
[/list]

[*] M1A2C
[*] M8-120 Thunderbolt II
[*] T-14 Armata (125mm only)

[/list]

notes.title: Of Wishlist Games, Changes and Future
notes.notes:
Commanders!

You’ve seen the signs. [b][url=https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/important-accounts-transfer-wishlist-games]The Account Transfer[/url][/b], [b][url=https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/important-support-transfer]new Support Service[/url][/b], the logos... and what’s more, you’ve seen some of the issues brought about by what seemed to you like rushed development in some regards. Well, today, we’d like to tell you more about the state of Armored Warfare, the past, the present, and the future.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/d6207fccc00d406a639fc2b50cba1e2d2f6d0fa1.jpg[/img]

[h2]THE PAST[/h2]

Let’s start at the beginning – with Wishlist Games. Wishlist Games is a production company founded and led by Armored Warfare veterans who looked at the game and saw potential unfulfilled. The Wishlist Games team – our team – had bigger dreams, dreams they started working on upon the game’s acquisition from Meta Publishing, introducing new idea concepts such as the upcoming Drone feature.

This was a lengthy process that started many months ago and you’ll have to forgive us that only now we are ready to share all this with you, the players. In the past months, we have scaled up the development team of Armored Warfare and hired not only skilled new people but also experienced veterans who have worked on the game before and their expertise contributed to the establishment of an excellent development team.

This all didn’t happen without hiccups as we are sure you noticed. These were compounded by the fact that around the same time, it was decided to move Armored Warfare away from the MY.GAMES platform to one of our own. Scaling up software development and bringing a lot of fresh faces on board is difficult at the best of times. Doing it simultaneously with an entirely new infrastructure though? Another beast entirely – one that bites and claws and we are extremely grateful that you stuck with us through it all despite receiving a few gashes and bruises in the process along with us.

[h2]THE PRESENT[/h2]

But we have weathered the worst part of the storm and, to stick with the maritime metaphors, it should be a far smoother sailing from now on. Our own infrastructure is largely built now and we will begin testing our new launcher shortly.

[url=https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/important-accounts-transfer-wishlist-games]You can help us by transferring your account as soon as possible as, starting from September 1, 2024, MY.GAMES login will no longer be available (which means the MY.GAMES launcher will not work).[/url]

To reward you for the hassle, we are preparing a gift that every transferring player will receive (even those who transferred the account before). We are also preparing the process for Steam and Epic Game Store account owners and we’ll keep you informed about the due process in the future.

[h2]THE FUTURE[/h2]

Own infrastructure is all well and good but surely you are wondering:

[i]“What does this all mean for us, the players?”[/i]

Very simply put, these steps will allow us to invest more resources into the game and see it grow. Here’s what’s going to happen.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/b465f3afed644606c22e9c25a6564892d5cd461a.jpg[/img]

Right now, we are in the final stages of finalizing the [b][url=https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-tales-dark-battle-path]Tales from the Dark Battle Path[/url][/b] that we hope you’ll enjoy. This event is bound to launch in early July and will serve as an introduction to a summer of fun and activities (for you) and speeding up the development of the game (for us). While it’s a bit too late to change the event’s economy based on its feedback, we’ll be scaling up the Battle Coin income by introducing:

[list]
[*] More free boosters (yes, they are returning to regular levels)
[*] More Battle Coin bonuses
[*] Free and easy bonus events awarding extra Battle Coins
[/list]

As such, the Battle Path will be easier to complete than the previous one. We are committed to acting upon your feedback (even though it sometimes takes us a bit longer than we would have wanted). Future Battle Paths will already have an overhauled (that is, more manageable) economy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/5c4b238641a2c4dc3b914d9126c628afeb37d737.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/e0bfa0a820fa3a30be914a5a3518eca566c405d0.jpg[/img]

But that’s not all. It’s not even the beginning.

This summer (end of July, presumably), we’ll be dropping two long-awaited features – [b]a new Special Operation mission and a new progression vehicle.[/b] The mission is called [b]Lone Star[/b] and will be nothing short of legendary for more reasons than one. We hope you’ll enjoy the spectacle.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/da62c1f54d9ddcf82f59c568bcd9554dd0fd0c66.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/e5d25cdaab720e498f6a6705773bd875d468fcae.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/2559e91a62e04cade3b9e869260fb3bb02180232.jpg[/img]

The progression vehicle is, of course, the long-awaited [b]T-80BVM Tier 9 MBT[/b]. We’ve had a lot of fun with this one (and not always in a good way) but in the end, perseverance wins the day and we are committed to our past promises as much as we humanly can. The Object 292 will be following after a few months as the model needs more work.

[b]Which brings us to the big thing.[/b]

For this autumn, aside from the usual content, we’re working on something big. It’s not just one thing – it is many things at once, culminating with... something unexpected, something even bigger, something we’re definitely not ready to share yet. But we’ll do our best to bring you the news as soon as possible.

We are sure you have questions. We are sure you also have doubts. But, once again, we’re committed to make Armored Warfare better for years to come and, in the following months, we’ll show you how. There might be more obstacles along the way and we may stumble once or twice. We are not perfect. But Armored Warfare is our passion project and always will be and we’ll treat it as such.

[b]See you on the battlefield![/b]

notes.title: Developer Diary: Russian Vehicle Changes
notes.notes:
Commanders!

As you already know, the Tales from the Dark Battle Path contains some Russian-themed content. We took the opportunity to take a look at the balance of some Russian vehicles and we’d like to tell you today about the changes will be making to them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/fc5a4fc6a4952e19b783d8aee9d7d96ae6229521.jpg[/img]

Contrary to popular belief, Russian vehicles in Armored Warfare aren’t typically performing extremely well with most being average at best. However, there definitely are a couple of outliers that are, at the moment at least, very much underperforming. In some cases, it’s because they have always been sort of weak. In other cases, the vehicles started as average but the world around them moved on, so to say. Here’s how we’ll address their situation.

Let’s start with the easy stuff – the [b]T-90 series[/b]. These tanks aren’t performing really well but don’t need truly massive buffs, which is why we thought we’d make them a bit interesting:

[list]
[*] T-90A will receive an additional module that significantly buffs the ERA by replacing its fillers with Relikt (the outer form remains the same) – the ERA will become significantly tougher
[*] T-90A will also receive a mobility buff with a new engine (1200hp V-99)
[*] T-90 will receive new 3VBM20 APFSDS (stock shells of T-90A)
[*] T-90 will also receive the Supercharged Soft Kill APS ability
[*] T-90M Proryv (new upcoming vehicle) will also receive a special hard-kill APS that can take down two missiles at once (very useful against those pesky double-launch ATGM enemies)
[*][/list]

[b]Object 640[/b] (and its “Black Eagle” variant) also deserves a buff:

[list]
[*] It will receive a new 1800hp turbine engine (GTD-1800), increasing the maximum speed to 95 km/h and the reverse speed by 10 km/h
[*] The magazine will increase to 5 rounds (without reload nerfs, this is a damage per minute value buff)
[*] The vehicle will receive the Vakuum-1 APFSDS round from T-14 Armata
[*] Ammo carried will increase to 75 rounds
[*] Camouflage will increase to 18 percent (due to the vehicle’s low profile)
[/list]

Speaking of the Armatas. [b]The old T-14 and T-14 152[/b] (as well as the Hades version) have for a long time been the “baseline” MBTs that other MBTs get compared to – a clear-cut case of some vehicles staying the same while everything around them moves on. Well, no more, because we’ll be giving them some buffs.

First, all vehicles will receive a side armor buff. Sadly we can’t simply turn the sides into ERA (it’s planned, but it’ll require a major model update) so we are buffing the side thickness to 735mm (or 1575mm versus HEAT).

Next, the engine. All T-14s will receive a new 2200hp engine called A-85-3AF with the following parameters:

[list]
[*] Maximum speed: 90 km/h
[*] Reverse speed: 42 km/h
[*] 0 to 32 km/h: 3.13s (3.26s for Armata 152)
[*] 0 to maximum speed: 25.27s (26.47s for Armata 152)
[*] Hull traverse rate: 44.61s
[/list]

Next, all T-14s will receive a new passive ability called APS Radar. In real life, the radar controlling the APS is fairly powerful. In game terms, it’ll reduce the camouflage of every enemy target within 350 meters by 10% (that is, deduces 10% from the original value).

But we haven’t forgotten the firepower either:

[list]
[*] Armata: 125mm Vakuum-1 APFSDS damage increased to 700
[*] Armata: 125mm Vakuum-2 APFSDS damage increased to 750
[*] Armata 152: We are adding a new APFSDS round Grifel-2 with 900mm penetration and 1150 damage
[*] Armata 152: We are adding a new HEAT ATGM called Kornet-T (1150mm penetration, 1100 damage, 200 non-penetration damage)
[*] Armata 152: We are adding a new thermobaric ATGM called 9M133F-3 (80mm penetration, 1000 damage)
[/list]

And, finally, we are also increasing the camouflage to 18% (as Armata is supposed to be quite stealthy).

Next, [b]Kornet-EM[/b]. Here we are increasing its armor from 5mm to 20mm (it’ll make it more resistant to machineguns) and are giving it a new 420hp engine with the following parameters:

[list]
[*] 0 to 32 km/h: 1.13s
[*] 0 to maximum speed: 23.21s
[/list]

In the end, [b]Kornet-EM[/b] doesn’t that big of a buff, unlike its tracked version called [b]Kornet-D1[/b]. This one’s getting two buffs:

[list]
[*] The ATGM Guidance System module also unlocks a thermobaric ATGM (80mm penetration, 1000 damage)
[*] We are adding a third mutually exclusive module to the previous two – this one will allow you to fire four missiles at once with 6 seconds between quad launches, followed by 43s of loading time
[/list]

This is some pretty extreme firepower but we’ll hope you’ll like it. The Kornet-D1 needs a serious buff and this level of firepower is as serious as it gets.

We hope you’ll like all of these changes and, as always:

[b]See you on the battlefield![/b]

Commanders!

We are happy to announce that the [b]Update 0.155[/b] is now available!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/705fa1d9713c5388fe8324943a1728edcb85fc3e.png[/img]

[h2]List of Update 0.155 Changes[/h2]

[b]Rollbacks from Previous Update[/b]

First and foremost, we are rolling back two features that we released in the previous update. The first rollback concerns the rework of the BWP-2000, which you, the players, were not happy about. Since we are committed to listen to your feedback wherever we can, we are rolling the BWP-2000 changes back and the vehicle will return to the pre-Update 0.150 state.

The second rollback is a bit more complicated. In the previous update, we have released the following change:

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue present on a large amount of vehicles where they could have more than one ATGM in the air at the same time when they should not
[/list]
This was a legitimate fix we thought fully justified because many of these vehicles were not supposed to do that. Unfortunately, we have discovered that due to a number of undocumented changes left behind the code, this broke a number of things, most notably:

[list]
[*] QN-506 drone missile switching/reload
[*] Kurganets’ Bulat missiles
[*] Stryker ADATS missiles
[/list]
This is why we are returning things to the previous state and all the affected vehicles should behave the way they had before.

In connection with this issue, we have discovered a special case in Stryker ADATS where the module that should be providing such a bonus is not doing anything as the vehicle uses the feature already by default. That is why we have added a new reload bonus to the module (improved the ADATS missile reload from 30s to 21.25s).

[b]Machinegun Elevation and Depression Fix
[/b]
In preparation for the release of the drones, we have heard your feedback and began to fix machinegun elevation and depression angles on all vehicles where they did not match the main armament. This is an ongoing process as some changes are more complicated than others but in this batch, we have addressed the issue on the following vehicles:

PT-85, Type 69, Type 79, T-55, T-62, Tiran 6, T-55 Enigma, Chieftain Mk.2, Type 80-II, T-64A Mod.1969, T-62M, T-55M1, Object 430, Type 85-IIM, T-80, T-72, T-72M1, T-72A, T-64A Mod.1976, Rooikat, Merkava Mk.1, Chieftain Mk.6, Chieftain Mk.10, Chieftain Mk.11, Type 96, Type 90-II, T-72M2 Wilk, T-72B, Merkava Mk.2B, Chieftain 900, Type 96A, T-90, T-80U, T-72M4CZ, Merkava Mk.2D, PTL-02, Type 99, VT4, 9910, Type 96B, T-90A, T-72B3, ST1, Merkava Mk.3 BAZ, Ariete, ASCOD LT, ZTL-11, VT5, Type 99A, Merkava Mk.4, T-90MS, Centauro 120, PL-01, Merkava Mk.4M and T-90A Burlak.

In addition to these changes, we have made several technical changes in preparation of the second stage of this fix. They are mostly not visible to players but there’s one exception – the Altay remote-controlled machinegun module is no longer moving with the gun (it was based on an obsolete animation scheme). We’ll return to the Altay in the next iteration.

[b]Vehicle Fixes and Updates[/b]

With each patch we continue (and will continue) to update vehicles based on your feedback and fix them. In this update, we have the following changes for you:

[list]
[*] Ajax: Increased the ammo capacity to 1200 rounds
[*] KF51 Panther: Increased the gun depression to -8 degrees
[*] KF51 Panther: Drone launcher no longer appears in the Upgrade window
[/list]
[b]General Changes[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed the issue of invisible UAVs on several maps (mostly Global Operations)
[*] Fixed several localization issues
[*] Added a number of future event assets
[/list]

We have added the appropriate achievements for Modern British Contract that awards you with AS90. You can now earn decals and a British camouflage by completing the contracts.

We have fixed a general error that caused the Kevlar Spall Liner module to add hitpoints to your ERA modules as well as your tank. This might sound like a good thing (and a nerf) but it is not due to the way ERA mechanics work.

The core problem with this issue was that the ERA mechanism was set so that if an ERA module had more hitpoints than the damage roll of an incoming shell, the game (very simply put) assumed the ERA did not work and only added the ERA’s armor thickness to the armor instead of the tile exploding.

notes.title: Developer Diary: Boxer RIWP Changes
notes.notes:
Commanders!

In today’s developer diary, we’ll discuss the changes we made to the Boxer RIWP Tier 10 Premium AFV.

[img]https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/screenshot0009_34.jpg[/img]

This vehicle was available as the top prize of the Exile Battle Path and the changes we made included specifically:
[list][*]Hydra turret no longer fires two rockets at once, adjusted the rate of fire to compensate[/*][*]TOW turret no longer fires two missiles at once, the time between launches changed to 2s[/*][*]Brimstone turret time between shots increased to 4s[/*][*]Starstreak turret no longer fires two missiles at once, adjusted the rate of fire to compensate[/*][*]Hybrid turret no longer fires two missiles at once, the time between launches changed to 2s[/*][/list]
One of the more common complaints from long-time players was that the turrets were too similar to play and, indirectly, there were two superior configurations that overshadowed all the others (Hydra and Brimstone). This limited the choice players had to pretty much one. In the current iteration, however, the launchers serve the following function:
[list][*][b]Hydra rocket pods[/b] are a much more reliable close-range fighting option as we made the rockets fire consistently instead of the previous double launches that were powerful but had a higher skill ceiling, making this configuration more comfortable to play[/*][*][b]TOW ATGM configuration[/b] was buffed and now represents a basic, reliable option that works for most situations. Previously, this configuration was underpowered and therefore underused but now represents a viable choice for players who do not have a preferred gameplay style and like things that work[/*][*][b]Brimstone ATGM configuration[/b] previously utterly overshadowed the TOW configuration. It’s still very powerful but instead of the more consistent damage output of the TWO configuration, you have longer reload times and therefore have to be a bit more careful how you aim (we kept the partial reload option in order not to nerf it to the ground)[/*][*][b]Starstreak configuration[/b] is a damage-output-centric long-range option to the Brimstones now as it no longer deals so much damage per shot due to the removal of the double launch option and requires players to stay more in the open to perform well – a nerf, but a needed one[/*][/list]
The [b]Hybrid configuration[/b] is still a work in progress as we aren’t really that happy about its performance. While the single launch Brimstone launchers do work better, the Javelin locking time seems excessive and we’ll be looking to reduce that to make the turret more comfortable.

Right now, the Boxer RIWP performs within expected parameters and, given its popularity, we consider the change a success. Do you though? Let us know on Discord and, as always:

[b]See you on the battlefield![/b]

notes.title: Update 0.117 Now Available

Commanders!

We are happy to announce that the [b]Update 0.117[/b] is now available!

[img]https://aw.my.games/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/image_s9i4_into_desolation_1920x1080.jpg[/img]

[h2]List of Update 0.117 Changes[/h2]

This update is bringing a large number of fixes for the current Battle Path vehicles as well as some other issues.

[b]PELE Improvements[/b]

In this update, we’re improving the PELE rounds for Boxer CRV and Puma. This is a straight up buff but it also deserves some context.

After the special HE airburst shells started suffering from the current problems for these two vehicles, their statistics dropped significantly. On one hand, this was a good thing – the airburst shells were clearly overperforming and we [url=https://aw.my.games/en/news/general/developer-diary-he-airburst-ammo-changes][b]had promised an adjustment[/b][/url] even before the current issue arose.

On the other hand, the statistics tanked so much we felt it wasn’t fair to you, the players. That is why, in addition to having standard HE shells, we are adjusting the PELE shells for the vehicles to perform better. In the future, with the introduction of correctly working airburst shells, the performance of the affected vehicles will once again be reviewed.

Additionally, we fixed the bugged part of PELE mechanics for the KF41.

notes.title: Update 0.110 Now Available
notes.notes:
Commanders!

We are happy to announce that the [b]Update 0.110[/b] is now available!

[img]https://aw.my.games/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/aw_as90_key_art_1920x1080.jpg[/img]

[h2]List of Update 0.110 Changes[/h2]

[b]HE Shell Fixes[/b]

In this update, we’re fixing some of the issues with HE shells that got into the game in the last patch, namely the disappearance of blast wave (splash) damage.

The good news first – artillery and other “regular” splash damage should be working correctly now, which accounts for the vast majority of vehicles. The bad news is that the issue causing the loss of splash is far deeper than we previously thought and is connected to multiple other issues (for example the infamous Puma performance loss).

That is why, as [b]a temporary measure[/b], Puma and Boxer CRV have had their airburst shells turned into regular ones. We do realize this is a massive nerf to their performance and are working on making the airburst shells work as intended (or at least compensate the performance loss by other buffs).

[b]General Changes[/b]
[list][*]AS90 is now available to players as a Contract vehicle[/*][*]Fixed the infamous Rate of Decay issue where players always spawned at the beginning of the map[/*][*]Fixed an issue where using the Retreat active ability incorrectly increased the rate of fire on multiple vehicles (most notably the Kornet-D1 and Ontos)[/*][*]Improved the matchmaking speed for the SPG class[/*][*]Boxer CRV: Fixed the vehicle’s size (we have made the vehicle smaller in order to correspond to its real-life parameters)[/*][*]Boxer CRV: Fixed an issue where its ATGMs would sometimes fly in the wrong direction[/*][*]Griffin 50mm: Fixed the appearance of the Tacticam skin (paint layout, some smaller parts weren’t painted etc.)[/*][*]KF41 Lynx Prototype: You can no longer shoot through some turret parts on the destroyed turret model[/*][*]Pindad: Adjusted the aiming circle appearance[/*][*]Puma: Fixed the camouflage appearance on this vehicle[/*][*]T-80UM-1: Fixed the achievement progress bar for this tank[/*][*]TOS-1M: Adjusted the aiming circle appearance[/*][*]Rate of Decay: Fixed a spot where players could get stuck at C3[/*][*]Fixed a large amount of specific cases where players would see a different vehicle in the acquisition screen when buying a new tank[/*][*]Removed the upper cap on the amount of Credits possible to own[/*][*]Added the Drone mechanic for future testing (currently not available)[/*][*]Added a number of assets for future events[/*][*]Fixed an issue that caused the server to crash earlier tonight[/*][*]Fixed some small user interface issues[/*][*]Fixed some small visual issues[/*][*]Fixed some small localization issues[/*][/list]

Commanders!

We are happy to announce that the [b]Update 0.90.60[/b] is now available!

[img]https://aw.my.games/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/ny_art_0.jpg[/img]

[h2]List of Update 0.90.60 Changes[/h2]

[b]Holiday Mode[/b]

This Christmas, we are once again enabling the Christmas Garage and the special Holiday Mode! A squad of snowmen took a magical sleigh and is dropping tree decorations over the village! Help Grandfather Frost gather the decorations and put them on the tree! Tree decorations will spawn across the map and it’s your and your team’s duty to pick each one up and bring it back to your base. But beware – evil Grinch-driven armored vehicles will stop at nothing to steal them from you, ruining your holidays!

Rules:
[list][*]The holiday mode can be selected in the Garage in the mode menu[/*][*]The match generally follows the rules of Global Operations with both sides having a number of points[/*][*]Capturing and bringing home the decorations resembles a Capture the Flag mode, each capture reduces enemy’s pool of points[/*][*]The first time a decoration spawns, it will always be in the center of the map, the rest of the spawns are random[/*][*]Player who captures a decoration will be clearly identified by an icon and visible on the minimap[/*][*]Destroying a vehicle carrying the decoration will cause the decoration to drop to the ground and become available for capture by someone else[/*][*]A new decoration spawns every 90 seconds[/*][*]It’s necessary to capture 5 decorations to win a match[/*][*]The match is played in 10v10 format and lasts 15 minutes[/*][/list]
[b]General Changes[/b]
[list][*]Contract Mission timer now works as intended (with the exception of stacking)[/*][*]Exile Battle Path: Elite missions now work as intended[/*][*]Penetration indicator now updates mostly without delay[/*][*]Fixed an issue where Mechanized Infantry wouldn’t shoot at targets effectively (however, there is still a bug remaining where its projectiles would sometimes disappear upon impact)[/*][*]Fixed an issue where Lynx Skyranger parts would appear in two separate groups in your inventory[/*][/list]

[b]Timer Corrections[/b]

We have fixed the timers for the upcoming Past to the Present event so that they work as before so that a single stage can be completed once per day and the timer then shows the time remaining to midnight UTC, at which point the stage resets.

We have also adjusted the timer for the Battle Path repeatable mission (72 hours). If you don’t complete a mission within 72 hours, another mission will become available straight after its completion.
